verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at console.groq.com/llms.txt and raw Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. overview.md returns HTTP 200). The docs are consistently published as .md URLs, so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
